title: B&O Railroad cannot be auctioned to Delta cheaply
description: B&O Railroad cannot be auctioned to Delta cheaply. Buying prevents the cash leader from assembling three railroads through an auction discount. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.private_thought: I have $580, own Pennsylvania RR. Buying B&O for $200 gives me 2 railroads, rent 50 each, improving cash flow. Cash after purchase $380 still healthy. No reason to auction; opponents unlikely to outbid me later. Secure second railroad now.

breakdown.message: Chooses buy_property for this exact purchase/auction context.
Stays on the purchase branch when the price is strategically justified.
Leaves at least $340 after the action.
Private thought names the live strategic pressure.
